text_en: Liandris, those Humans I was made aware of... I must know the circumstances of their arrival on Terragaya.
Preparing? They did not die in combat?
No, but we were called to their location, a place where they found themselves sealed off and isolated, not just from their own world, but from the universe
And they arrived not long after those beings began to appear on the planet's surface...
Is something the matter, my lady?
Nothing deserving of my time or energy at this moment. Keep your distance from them and visit Terragaya only when strictly necessary.
